name: SCU Elite Athlete and Performer Program
summary: Study flexibility and case-by-case grants for travel, registration and competition costs for elite athletes and performers at SCU.
who: Athletes identified as elite by a listed body, such as a state academy or institute of sport or a national senior squad.
Performers in significant state, national or international performances.
how: Apply online with a club or coach support letter and photos.
Claim approved costs with the Elite Athlete and Performer Expense Form.
catches: No amounts are listed. Applications are reviewed case by case.
The panel reviews current-student applications at the end of each term.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Elite athletes and performers

evidence.quote: Applications are reviewed on a case-by-case basis
